notes.title: ver 1.3.0: Update Notice
notes.notes:
New Content
Enhanced dice and enchanted dice now appear as rewards
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where you couldn’t view the details of enemy hand dice
UI Improvements
Added map descriptions

Changed pre–dice-roll behavior

notes.title: ver 1.2.0: Update Notice
notes.notes:
Balance
Changed initial skill in the Draw Phase from Reload with selection to Reload without selection
Content
Added “?” tiles to the map


Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where the Doubles Relic glowed even when the dice were not doubles

Fixed a bug where unimplemented enchants could appear when reloading repeatedly

Fixed incorrect text in dice effect descriptions


UI
Improved the pacing of the dice roll animation during battles

Made dice effect explanations during combat easier to read

Added emphasis to the current roll result

Highlighted important buttons

Improved overall wording in descriptions

notes.title: ver 1.1.0: Update Notice
notes.notes:
Balance
Enemy skill changes (removed enemy skills; changed effect from increasing enemy skill points to decreasing player skill points)

Changed map length from 13 to 11

Changed the second event on the map to always be a combat encounter
Content
Added new relics and new enchants


Bug Fixes
Minor bug fixes for relics


UI
Hide the previous total during dice rerolls

Display related dice details next to the card
